'''Beramsh''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who led the first surveys of [[Tandun III]].

==Biography==
In [[12,293 BBY]], Dr. Beramsh led an expedition from [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] to Tandun III. Beramsh supervised the exploration of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and found massive ancient population centers the [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] theorized were constructed by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. Though Dr. Beramsh's survey had proven that Tandun III was suitable for colonization, it was never colonized before its destruction in [[43 ABY]].
